PROJECT DESCRIPTION/SCOPE OF WORK
THE PROJECT INCLUDES CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW 4-STORY HOTEL THAT SITS ADJACENT, AND ABUTS AN EXISTING 
HISTORIC STRUCTURE.  THE NEW HOTEL WILL BE SEPARATED FROM THE EXISTING HISTORIC BUILDING BY A 3 HOUR 
FIRE WALL.  THE PROJECT WILL BE TYPE IIIB CONSTRUCTION.  THE ADJACENT, EXISTING HISTORIC BUILDING IS TYPE 
VB.  THE EXISTING HISTORIC BUILDING IS BEING PERMITTED SEPARATELY.
THE NEW STRUCTURE INCLUDES PARKING AT GRADE ALONG THE REAR ALLEY, A RETAIL SPACE, A DINING 
ESTABLISHMENT AND BAR ON THE TOP FLOOR, AND A HOTEL LOBBY WITH A BAR AND SERVICE KITCHEN ON LEVEL 1.  
THE BAR, DINING, AND KITCHEN AREAS ARE BEING PERMITTED AS CORE AND SHELL SPACES FOR PURPOSES OF THIS 
PERMIT.  THE LAYOUT AND DESIGN OF THOSE SPACES WILL BE SUBMITTED UNDER A SEPARATE PERMIT.  
PROJECT WILL BE FULLY SPRINKLERED.  THE PROJECT IS A MULTI-STORY MIXED OCCUPANCY BUILDING THAT IS 
PERMITTED WITH SEPARATED OCCUPANCIES PER IBC SECTION 508.4.   A PORTION LEVEL 1 IS PERMITTED AS NON-
SEPARATED OCCUPANCIES.

EXTERIOR LIGHTING.

LIGHTING CONTROL PANEL WITH LOW-VOLTAGE SWITCHES FOR

AFF. COORDINATE EXACT LOCATION WITH ARCHITECT.  JACKS AND

4. CONTRACTOR MEANS AND METHODS UTILIZED TO INSTALL WIRING 
DEVICES WITHIN 1-HOUR RATED WALLS, SUCH HAS STAGGERED 
SPACING OF BACK-TO-BACK DEVICES AND/OR USE OF FIRE RATED 
PUTTY PADS, SHALL MAINTAIN WALL RATING.
5. PROVIDE ELECTRICAL CONNECTION TO DWELLING UNIT 
CONDENSING UNITS LOCATED ON BUILDING ROOFTOP.  RE: 
BUILDING ROOF PLAN FOR CONDENSING UNIT LOCATIONS AND 
MECHANICAL EQUIPMENT SCHEDULE FOR WIRING REQUIREMENTS.
6. COORDINATE LOCATION AND MOUNTING HEIGHTS OF ELECTRICAL 
DEVICES IN MILLWORK WITH ARCHITECT/OWNER PRIOR TO ROUGH-
IN.
7. CONFIRM MOUNTING HEIGHT AND LOCATION OF ALL LUMINAIRES 
AND DEVICES WITH ARCHITECT PRIOR TO ROUGH IN.
8. COORDINATE EXACT ELECTRICAL REQUIREMENTS AND LOCATIONS 
OF MECHANICAL AND PLUMBING EQUIPMENT WITH MECHANICAL 
AND PLUMBING CONTRACTOR PRIOR TO ROUGH-IN.
9. RECEPTACLES INDICATED TO BE MOUNTED ABOVE COUNTER 
SHALL BE MOUNTED HORIZONTALLY 6" ABOVE COUNTER TO THE 
CENTERLINE OF THE DEVICE UNO.
10. COUNTERTOP RECEPTACLES SHALL BE INSTALLED AT 6" ABOVE 
THE BACK SPLASH TO THE CENTERLINE OF THE DEVICE UNO.
11. ALL RECEPTACLES WITHIN 6' OF A SINK SHALL BE GFCI.
12. GFCI PROTECTION IS INDICATED AS REQUIRED.  GFCI TRIP SWITCH 
SHALL BE IN ACCESSIBLE LOCATION, EITHER AT ACCESSIBLE 
RECEPTACLE, A REMOTE-MOUNTEDGFCI SWITCH, OR AT CIRCUIT 
BREAKER. DO NOT PROVIDE GFCI PROTECTION IN TWO LOCATIONS.
13. ALL 120V RECEPTACLES TO BE TAMPER-PROOF.
14. WHERE BOTH AFCI AND GFCI PROTECTION ARE REQUIRED, 
PROVIDE PROTECTION AT CIRCUIT BREAKER. DO NOT PROVIDE 
PROTECTION IN MORE THAN ONE LOCATION. REFER TO LOAD 
CENTER SCHEDULE(S) FOR FURTHER INFORMATION.
15. NUMBERS ADJACENT TO DEVICES ON ELECTRICAL ENLARGED 
GUEST ROOM PLANS INDICATE CIRCUITING. SEE ELECTRICAL 
POWER PLANS FOR BRANCH PANEL CIRCUITING.
